fields.constraint: A landslide at kilometre 31 has narrowed the road. Light vehicles can pass one at a time under a marshal; trucks over 3.5 tonnes cannot.
fields.vehicles: Light vehicles and pickups; no trucks over 3.5 tonnes.
fields.duration: At least five days; the road authority is clearing with one excavator.
alternatives: Route 9 is open in daylight and adds about three hours.
Air drop by helicopter can be requested through the logistics cluster.
